data.name: Bipasha
data.gender_notes: Bipasha is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The goddess of fearlessness and fortitude, Bipasha signifies fearlessness and bravery in appearance. The name Bipasha carries the meaning “Bravery in appearance” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bipasha usually hope their child will grow to embody bravery in appearance and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Bipasha belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Bravery in appearance.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bipasha total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
